description: Versioned candidate boundaries, not an execution receipt. New repository validation must record its own exact source and results.

secure_launcher.required_evidence: independent exact-source review and executable isolated start/stop/restart evidence

git_runtime.normal_user_contract: checked before Setup install mutation and before UI mount/server start
git_runtime.security_intent: --no-lazy-fetch is preserved; old or missing Git fails closed, never made green by dropping that control

restore_capability.implementation: SQLite-only product wrapper and offline restore controller; approved non-reparse Storage root and no live runtime ownership

candidate_runtime.backend_and_ui: one loopback FastAPI process plus pre-built Vue assets on the same authority
candidate_runtime.runtime_state: developer local-run.json or installed installed-run.json under the product data root
candidate_runtime.provenance: runtime-manifest.json with ordered file size/SHA-256 entries and source commit; distribution layer independently re-attests exact payload member set before ZIP creation
candidate_runtime.diagnostics_binding: single runtime-manifest-bound payload/AnxinBoard.Runtime/tools/collect-diagnostics.ps1; no separate top-level diagnostics copy
candidate_runtime.installed_runtime_resolver: implemented; verifies active pointer, manifest digest, exact runtime tree, ancestor reparse chain and runtime/frontend/diagnostics bindings, and returns only a relative executable path; performs no launcher/session/credential authority
candidate_runtime.launcher_authority: reuse versioned secure launcher; independent exact-source review and executable evidence required

reusable_security_boundaries.start_entry: versioned secure launcher with one-time in-memory browser bootstrap; no credential access at startup
reusable_security_boundaries.stop_entry: existing identity-checked stop authority; never terminate by port alone
reusable_security_boundaries.local_session: reuse existing one-bootstrap/one-session in-memory guard and exact loopback-origin validation
reusable_security_boundaries.credential_store: reuse Windows Credential Manager Generic Credentials in fixed AnxinBoard/ namespace
reusable_security_boundaries.ordinary_backup_scope: SQLite product database snapshot only; Credential Manager is not read or serialized
reusable_security_boundaries.backup_export_authorization: guarded by existing same-origin local session; response is no-store; temporary package is cleaned after send
reusable_security_boundaries.program_path_reparse_policy: existing install/rollback/resolver/uninstall ancestor chains and program tree members are fail-closed against reparse redirection
reusable_security_boundaries.diagnostics_path_reparse_policy: data/output roots reject reparse; DB/runtime-state/runtime-manifest reparse files are never followed
